decisions.decision: Marking breadth follows the cause, not the transport
decisions.rationale: shadowSilent and controllerLinkLost are the same physical situation — this pump's data stopped refreshing while the cloud is fine — and withdraw an identical 7 scopes. Only the struct each was born in made one account-wide. credentialsRejected and restDegraded stay account-wide because those causes genuinely affect every pump.

decisions.decision: The controller-link log must name every service it marks
decisions.rationale: It marks 16 and tells the operator about 11, silently omitting the Self-Test and Alarm Mute switches. Fixed as its own change, not folded into the marking work.

decisions.decision: The silence timer moves to a forward-only counter
decisions.rationale: Date.now() means a backwards clock jump larger than the ~30-minute window leaves a dead pump reading as trustworthy indefinitely. Forward jumps only mark early, which is harmless. The Clock port is already injected everywhere.

decisions.decision: The CR-03 guard stays; its stated reason was false and is corrected
decisions.rationale: A 90-minute live probe saw 7 messages, all carrying telemetry, metadata never alone — so the documented vendor shape was not observed. The guard is live anyway: toReportedPatch yields data:undefined for null, string or array sections, and isShadowDocument validates two levels only. The danger closed is a reader measuring the vendor, finding nothing, and deleting a live safety boundary on correct reasoning from a false premise.

decisions.decision: Arming the silence timer on telemetry rather than on any message was considered and NOT chosen
decisions.rationale: Recorded as available in ledger entry 41. Do not implement it without a fresh ruling.

next_action: Decide between two ready paths: scope entries 19, 6 and 14 as one phase (they share four modules and the two-pump harness), or ship Phase 5 first and take them afterwards. Phase 5 is verified 4/4 and needs no further work. If shipping first, the 13 open ledger entries must be dispositioned because /gsd-ship blocks on them.
context_notes: Phase 5 is DONE — 19 plans, verified passed at 4/4 by executing the shipped code across nine probe files and twelve mutations. Do not re-run waves 8-14; the previous checkpoint said they were unexecuted and that is now superseded. This session's through-line was the phase's own defining defect appearing at four successive layers: in shipped code, in the tests meant to pin it, in the validation records, and finally in a plan whose purpose was correcting a validation record — whose suite gates were piped into tail so a red suite would have reported success. Every layer was caught by checking rather than by reasoning. The most valuable single behaviour observed, ten times over, was an agent measuring a premise its own plan asserted and reporting it false.
